title: DeepSeekMath-V2: Towards Self-Verifiable Mathematical Reasoning
authors_zh: Zhihong Shao、Yuxiang Luo、Chengda Lu、Z.Z. Ren、Jiewen Hu、Tian Ye、Zhibin Gou、Shirong Ma、Xiaokang Zhang
paper_type_zh: 自然语言数学证明生成—验证前沿报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 研究自然语言 proof verifier、meta-verification、GRPO 数据飞轮和测试时搜索审计的读者
one_line: DeepSeekMath-V2 alternates GRPO-trained proof verification and generation, bootstraps harder proof labels through multi-sample verifier and meta-verifier judgments, and scales self-verification at test time, while releasing model weights and evaluation artifacts but not the training records or formal correctness certificates.
DeepSeekMath-V2 以专家三级标签训练自然语言 proof verifier 和 meta-verifier，再通过多采样自动标注与 GRPO 形成生成—验证闭环；其价值是披露反馈型数据飞轮，但 LLM 判断与 64 次一致通过都不是 Lean/Isabelle 形式证明证书。
why: It is an unusually concrete frontier disclosure of how proof problems, generated proofs, expert scores, verifier analyses, meta-verification, learned rewards, and test-time search form a data flywheel, while exposing the audit gap between LLM agreement and formally verified mathematics.
inclusion_reason: A frontier mathematical-reasoning report that exposes a generator-verifier scaling loop, expert-scored proof and meta-verification records, explicit GRPO reward formulas, fully automated hard-proof labeling in later iterations, and verifier-guided test-time search while leaving training datasets, calibration, contamination controls, and record-level lineage incomplete.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official arXiv v1 of DeepSeekMath-V2: Towards Self-Verifiable Mathematical Reasoning was submitted on November 27, 2025 by nine DeepSeek-AI authors. It addresses a failure of final-answer reward for theorem proving: a numerically correct answer can conceal invalid reasoning, and many proof tasks have no short answer that a program can compare with a key. The paper therefore studies whether an LLM can learn to identify issues in natural-language proofs and provide feedback for proof-generation RL and test-time refinement.

The central data objects are judgment-bearing natural-language records, not formal proof objects. Initial verifier data D_v contains a problem X, a generated proof Y, and a mathematical expert score s in {0, 0.5, 1}. Meta-verifier data D_mv adds the verifier analysis V and an expert quality score ms in the same three-level set. Generator records add a proof, a self-analysis, a self-score, external verifier score, and meta-verification feedback. In the final two training iterations, new hard proofs are labeled through repeated verifier and meta-verifier sampling instead of human annotation.

This distinction defines the Card's boundary. DeepSeekMath-V2 evaluates prose proofs with learned natural-language judges. It does not compile Lean or Isabelle terms and does not produce machine-checked certificates. Passing 64 verifier attempts means that 64 sampled LLM analyses found no disqualifying issue under a shared learned rubric; it is a high-confidence search condition followed by selected expert assessment, not guaranteed mathematical validity.

The paper belongs in frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger because it exposes an unusually detailed generator–verifier data flywheel, explicit reward formulas, expert-label schemas, and test-time budgets while withholding the training records, auto-label parameters, calibration evidence, contamination audit, and record lineage. L4 means the full paper, appendices, official repository, released evaluation inputs and outputs, and model page support a bilingual audit Card. It does not mean the training dataset or pipeline is reusable.

官方 arXiv v1 的 DeepSeekMath-V2: Towards Self-Verifiable Mathematical Reasoning 由九位 DeepSeek-AI 作者于 2025 年 11 月 27 日提交。它针对 theorem proving 中 final-answer reward 的失效：数值答案正确可能掩盖无效推理，许多证明任务也没有可由程序直接与答案键比较的短答案。因此，论文研究 LLM 能否学会识别自然语言证明中的问题，并为证明生成 RL 和测试时 refinement 提供反馈。

核心数据对象是带判断的自然语言记录，而不是形式证明对象。初始 verifier 数据 D_v 包含问题 X、生成证明 Y 和数学专家给出的 {0, 0.5, 1} 分数 s。Meta-verifier 数据 D_mv 进一步加入 verifier analysis V 和同样三级的专家质量分数 ms。Generator 记录还包含证明、自分析、自评分、外部 verifier 分数和 meta-verification 反馈。最后两轮训练中，新的 hard proof 不再由人工标注，而通过 verifier 与 meta-verifier 多次采样自动赋标签。

这一差异定义了本 Card 的边界。DeepSeekMath-V2 用学习得到的自然语言 judge 评估文本证明，不编译 Lean 或 Isabelle term，也不产生机器检查证书。“通过 64 次 verifier 检查”表示在同一学习 rubric 下，64 个采样的 LLM analysis 均未找到足以否定证明的问题；它是随后结合选定专家评估的高置信搜索条件，不是数学有效性的保证。

本论文属于 frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger，因为它披露了异常具体的 generator–verifier 数据飞轮、reward 公式、专家标签 schema 和测试时预算，同时未公开训练记录、自动标注参数、校准证据、污染审计和 record lineage。这里的 L4 表示全文、附录、官方仓库、已发布评测输入与输出和模型页足以支撑双语审计 Card，不表示训练数据集或流水线可复用。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The one-sentence contribution is: DeepSeekMath-V2 alternates training a natural-language proof verifier and a proof generator, uses a learned meta-verifier to constrain false-rigor in issue analyses, and replaces human labels with multi-sample automated judgments in the last two iterations.

The initial verifier consumes (problem, proof) and writes an issue summary plus score 1 for complete and rigorous, 0.5 for sound overall logic with minor errors or omissions, or 0 for fatal errors or critical gaps (Paper §2.1.1; Appendix A.2). Its first RL reward multiplies a programmatic format indicator by 1 - |predicted score - expert score|. This aligns the scalar label but does not supervise whether described defects exist. The paper explicitly observes that a verifier can earn full reward by predicting the right score while hallucinating flaws.

Meta-verification adds a second learned judgment surface. Mathematical experts score whether a verifier analysis correctly identifies real issues and justifies its proof score; a meta-verifier learns this task, and enhanced verifier reward becomes R_format × R_score × R_meta (§2.1.2). The proof generator then receives the verifier's proof score and is trained to emit both a Solution and Self Evaluation; its reward uses alpha=0.76 for proof quality and beta=0.24 for accurate self-assessment, where self-score agreement is multiplied by meta-verification (§2.2.2).

What these systems observe is rubric-consistent natural-language judgment. They can flag plausible gaps and reward self-correction without a reference solution, but they cannot guarantee that all mathematical dependencies were checked. Appendix A.3 further instructs the meta-verifier to accept a no-defect analysis as reasonable even when the proof itself is obviously wrong; it validates asserted defects rather than directly penalizing omitted defects. This creates a false-negative surface that repeated related-model judgments may share.

The direction is learned proof feedback for natural-language theorem proving. The closest contrast is DeepSeek-Prover-V2 or AlphaProof, where a formal assistant provides a programmatic terminal predicate. DeepSeekMath-V2 instead makes verification scalable over prose but less conclusive. Its novelty is the feedback-and-labeling loop, not a formal proof checker.

一句话贡献是：DeepSeekMath-V2 交替训练自然语言 proof verifier 与 proof generator，用学习得到的 meta-verifier 约束 issue analysis 中的 false-rigor，并在最后两轮以多采样自动判断替代人工标签。

初始 verifier 接收 (problem, proof)，输出 issue summary，并按 rubric 给出三级分数：完整严谨为 1，总体逻辑成立但有小错误或遗漏为 0.5，存在致命错误或关键缺口为 0（论文 §2.1.1；Appendix A.2）。其首个 RL reward 是 programmatic format indicator 与 1 - |预测分数 - 专家分数| 的乘积。这会对齐标量标签，却不监督所描述缺陷是否真实存在。论文明确观察到，verifier 可以预测正确分数并虚构缺陷，从而获得满额 reward。

Meta-verification 加入第二个学习判断面。数学专家评价 verifier analysis 是否正确识别真实问题并足以支撑其 proof score；meta-verifier 学习此任务，增强后的 verifier reward 为 R_format × R_score × R_meta（§2.1.2）。随后 proof generator 接收 verifier 的 proof score，并被训练同时输出 Solution 与 Self Evaluation；其 reward 以 alpha=0.76 加权 proof quality，以 beta=0.24 加权 accurate self-assessment，其中自评分一致性还要乘 meta-verification（§2.2.2）。

这些系统观察到的是符合 rubric 的自然语言判断。它们可以在没有参考答案时标记看似合理的缺口并奖励自我修正，却不能保证所有数学依赖均被检查。Appendix A.3 还要求 meta-verifier：即使证明明显错误，只要原 verifier 声称没有缺陷，也应将该 no-defect analysis 视为合理；因此它验证被提出的缺陷，而不直接惩罚遗漏缺陷。这形成了假阴性表面，相关模型的重复判断可能共同继承该盲区。

它代表的方向是自然语言 theorem proving 的 learned proof feedback。最接近的对照是 DeepSeek-Prover-V2 或 AlphaProof，其中形式证明助手提供 programmatic terminal predicate。DeepSeekMath-V2 让文本证明验证更易扩展，但结论性更弱。其新意是反馈和标注闭环，而不是形式证明检查器。

title: Method
方法
html:
The disclosed construction pipeline is:

  1. Problem pool. Crawl 17,503 AoPS contest problems, prioritizing olympiads, team-selection tests, post-2010 items, and problems explicitly requiring proofs; call the pool D_p (Paper §2.1.1, p.3). The crawl manifest, rights ledger, duplicate policy, and evaluation exclusions are not released.
  2. Initial proof generation. A DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp-Thinking variant writes candidate natural-language proofs and iteratively refines them over multiple rounds. Generator identity, number of rounds, sampler, temperature, candidates per task, and retention are unknown.
  3. Expert proof labels. Randomly sample proofs across mathematical types and ask mathematical experts to assign s ∈ {0, 0.5, 1}. This creates D_v={(X_i,Y_i,s_i)}. Expert count, labels per proof, agreement, adjudication, and dataset size are undisclosed.
  4. Verifier RL. Start from a DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp-SFT checkpoint trained on undisclosed mathematics and code reasoning data. The verifier writes an issue analysis and boxed score. Initial reward is R_format × R_score, with R_score=1-|s'-s|; format checking validates required phrases and boxed syntax, not mathematics.
  5. Meta-verifier RL. Experts score verifier analyses with ms ∈ {0, 0.5, 1}, producing D_mv={(X_i,Y_i,V_i,ms_i)}. A learned meta-verifier scores analysis quality. Enhanced verifier reward is R_format × R_score × R_meta, and the verifier is trained on both datasets.
  6. Generator RL and self-verification. Use the verifier's proof score as generator reward. Require the generator to output a proof followed by self-analysis and self-score. Reward is R_format × (0.76 R_Y + 0.24 R_Z), where R_Z combines agreement between self-score and verifier score with meta-verification of the self-analysis (§2.2.2).
  7. Iterative scaling and late automation. The improved generator produces harder proofs. Earlier hard-proof labeling uses multiple verifier analyses to assist experts. In the last two iterations, automation generates n independent verifier analyses; for analyses scored 0 or 0.5, it generates m meta-assessments and accepts an asserted issue by majority. If at least k validated analyses agree on the lowest score, assign that score; if no legitimate issue is found across all n, assign 1; otherwise discard or route to humans (§2.3, pp.5–6). Numeric n, m, k, yields, class balance, and human-routing rates are unknown.
  8. Optimization sequence. Use GRPO, first improving verification and then initializing and optimizing the proof generator from that checkpoint. From iteration two, initialize the verifier from a rejection-fine-tuned checkpoint consolidating prior verification and generation ability (§3.1, p.6). GRPO/RFT code, hyperparameters, optimizer details, rollout counts, compute, and checkpoint hashes are not released.
  9. Test-time use. One-shot evaluation samples 8 proofs and uses majority vote across 8 verifier analyses. Sequential refinement uses a 128K per-attempt limit, up to 8 attempts, 32 threads, and 32 verifier analyses; it stops on self-score 1 or the attempt cap. High-compute search initializes 64 proofs with 64 analyses each, retains the 64 highest-average candidates, pairs each with 8 selected analyses, and iterates up to 16 rounds or until one proof passes all 64 LLM-verifier attempts (§3.3).

Reproduction requires the unavailable training records, expert protocol, generator/verifier/meta-verifier versions, n/m/k, sampled and rejected records, reward code, GRPO/RFT implementation, split and contamination ledger, and checkpoint lineage. The released repository supplies inference/evaluation templates, selected contest inputs and predictions, and model weights. Those artifacts do not reconstruct training or constitute a training-data release.

已披露构造流水线如下：

  1. 问题池。 抓取 17,503 道 AoPS 竞赛题，优先选择奥赛、国家队选拔、2010 年后题目和明确要求证明的题目，并记作 D_p（论文 §2.1.1，第 3 页）。抓取 manifest、权利台账、重复策略和评测排除清单未发布。
  2. 初始证明生成。 一个 DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp-Thinking 变体生成自然语言候选证明，并经多轮迭代 refinement。Generator 身份、轮数、sampler、temperature、每题 candidate 数和保留策略均为 unknown。
  3. 专家证明标签。 跨数学类型随机抽样证明，由数学专家给出 s ∈ {0, 0.5, 1}，形成 D_v={(X_i,Y_i,s_i)}。专家人数、每条证明标签数、一致性、仲裁和数据集大小均未披露。
  4. Verifier RL。 从一个使用未披露数学与代码 reasoning 数据训练的 DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp-SFT checkpoint 开始。Verifier 输出 issue analysis 和 boxed score。初始 reward 是 R_format × R_score，其中 R_score=1-|s'-s|；format check 只验证必需短语和 boxed 语法，不验证数学。
  5. Meta-verifier RL。 专家用 ms ∈ {0, 0.5, 1} 评价 verifier analysis，形成 D_mv={(X_i,Y_i,V_i,ms_i)}。学习得到的 meta-verifier 对 analysis quality 评分。增强后的 verifier reward 是 R_format × R_score × R_meta，verifier 同时在两个数据集上训练。
  6. Generator RL 与 self-verification。 用 verifier 的 proof score 作为 generator reward，要求 generator 输出证明、自分析和自评分。Reward 为 R_format × (0.76 R_Y + 0.24 R_Z)，其中 R_Z 将自评分与 verifier score 的一致性同 self-analysis 的 meta-verification 结合（§2.2.2）。
  7. 迭代扩展与后两轮自动化。 改进后的 generator 产生更难证明。早期 hard-proof 标注用多个 verifier analysis 辅助专家；最后两轮完全自动化：先生成 n 个独立 verifier analysis；对分数为 0 或 0.5 的 analysis 生成 m 个 meta-assessment，并以多数票确认所述缺陷。如果至少 k 个有效 analysis 同意最低分，就赋该分；若全部 n 次均未发现合法问题，则赋 1；否则丢弃或转人工（§2.3，第 5–6 页）。数值 n、m、k、产出率、类别平衡和人工转交率均为 unknown。
  8. 优化序列。 使用 GRPO，先优化 verification，再从该 checkpoint 初始化并优化 proof generator。从第二轮起，verifier 从一个 rejection-fine-tuned checkpoint 初始化，后者整合前一轮 verification 与 generation 能力（§3.1，第 6 页）。GRPO/RFT 代码、超参数、optimizer 细节、rollout 数、计算量和 checkpoint hash 均未发布。
  9. 测试时用途。 One-shot 评测每题采样 8 份证明，并对 8 个 verifier analysis 做多数投票。Sequential refinement 每次最多 128K token，最多 8 次尝试、32 条 thread 和 32 个 verifier analysis；自评分达到 1 或预算耗尽时停止。High-compute search 初始生成 64 份证明，每份配 64 个 analysis，保留平均分最高的 64 个 candidate，每个再配 8 个选定 analysis，最多迭代 16 轮，或当某份证明通过全部 64 个 LLM-verifier attempt 时停止（§3.3）。

复现需要未发布的训练记录、专家 protocol、generator/verifier/meta-verifier 版本、n/m/k、采样及拒绝记录、reward 代码、GRPO/RFT 实现、split 与污染台账以及 checkpoint lineage。公开仓库提供 inference/evaluation template、部分竞赛输入和 prediction，以及模型权重；这些 artifact 不能重建训练，也不构成训练数据发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Verifier evidence is reported on an unspecified validation split of D_v. Adding meta-verification raises the average quality of proof analyses from 0.85 to 0.96 as scored by the learned meta-verifier, while proof-score prediction accuracy is reported unchanged (Paper §2.1.2, p.4). This isolates the intended change—more faithful issue descriptions—but the split size, confidence intervals, independent expert confirmation, and per-class false-positive and false-negative rates are absent. The evaluator is also the learned meta-verifier used by the method.

One-shot results on 91 in-house CNML-level problems use 8 proof samples per model and majority vote across 8 analyses from the final verifier. Figure 1 reports mean proof scores by category and shows DeepSeekMath-V2 above GPT-5-Thinking-High and Gemini 2.5-Pro under that verifier (§3.3.1, p.7). Sequential refinement on the 31 ISL 2024 problems uses a 128K single-attempt limit, 32 independent threads, up to 8 attempts, and 32 final-verifier analyses. Figure 2 reports Pass@1 rising from 0.15 at one attempt to 0.27 at eight attempts and Best@32 from 0.26 to 0.42; Best@32 is selected by generator self-scores (§3.3.2, pp.7–8). These are learned-verifier-conditioned results, not formal checks.

High-compute contest results use one final model for both generation and verification. Each problem begins with 64 proof samples and 64 verifier analyses per proof; the system retains 64 highest-average candidates, pairs each with 8 selected analyses, and runs up to 16 iterations or until one proof passes all 64 LLM-verifier attempts. Mathematical experts then assess the highest-scoring proofs (§3.3.3, pp.8–9). Under these conditions, Table 1 reports five of six IMO 2025 problems fully solved for 83.3%, four CMO 2024 problems fully solved plus partial credit on another for 73.8%, and 11 of 12 Putnam 2024 problems fully solved plus minor errors on the last for 118/120 or 98.3%. “64/64” is the search stopping condition for verifier agreement on fully solved candidates, not a Lean/Isabelle certificate.

For IMO-ProofBench, Figure 3 reports expert grading of DeepSeekMath-V2 Heavy at 99.0% on the 30-problem Basic subset and 61.9% on the 30-problem Advanced subset. The DeepSeekMath-V2 proofs were graded by the authors' experts under benchmark guidelines, whereas baseline numbers were sourced from Luong et al.; expert identities, blinding, agreement, and raw grading records are not released. The paper notes that the hardest IMO-level problems remain challenging.

The official repository verifies model and evaluation artifacts: prompt templates, inference/search scripts, selected contest inputs, and JSONL predictions with automatic and human ratings. The official Hugging Face page verifies a 685B weight release and Apache 2.0 terms for the model/repository. Neither source releases D_p, D_v, D_mv, automatic hard-proof labels, RFT data, GRPO training code, reward implementation, or a licensed training corpus. Reported results are author claims under the stated budgets and judging conditions; no independent reproduction is claimed.

Verifier 证据来自 D_v 一个大小未说明的 validation split。加入 meta-verification 后，proof analysis 的平均质量分数从 0.85 提升到 0.96，该分数由学习得到的 meta-verifier 给出；proof-score prediction accuracy 据报告保持不变（论文 §2.1.2，第 4 页）。这对应预期变化——更忠实的问题描述——但 split 大小、置信区间、独立专家确认以及分类别假阳性/假阴性率均缺失。Evaluator 还是方法自身使用的 learned meta-verifier。

91 道内部 CNML-level 问题的 one-shot 结果，对每个模型每题采样 8 份证明，并对 final verifier 的 8 个 analysis 做多数投票。图 1 报告分领域 mean proof score，并显示在该 verifier 下 DeepSeekMath-V2 高于 GPT-5-Thinking-High 与 Gemini 2.5-Pro（§3.3.1，第 7 页）。对 31 道 ISL 2024 问题的 sequential refinement 使用单次 128K token 上限、32 条独立 thread、最多 8 次尝试和 32 个 final-verifier analysis。图 2 报告 Pass@1 从一次尝试的 0.15 升至八次尝试的 0.27，Best@32 从 0.26 升至 0.42；Best@32 由 generator self-score 选择（§3.3.2，第 7–8 页）。这些结果以 learned verifier 为条件，不是形式检查结果。

High-compute 竞赛结果使用同一个 final model 同时生成和验证。每道题从 64 个 proof sample 开始，每份证明配 64 个 verifier analysis；系统保留平均分最高的 64 个 candidate，每个配 8 个选定 analysis，最多迭代 16 轮，或当某份证明通过全部 64 个 LLM-verifier attempt 时停止。随后数学专家评估得分最高的证明（§3.3.3，第 8–9 页）。在这些条件下，表 1 报告 IMO 2025 六题完整解出五题，得分 83.3%；CMO 2024 完整解出四题并有一题获得部分分，得分 73.8%；Putnam 2024 十二题完整解出十一题，最后一题有小错误，得分 118/120，即 98.3%。“64/64”是完整候选证明上 verifier 一致通过的搜索停止条件，不是 Lean/Isabelle 证书。

对于 IMO-ProofBench，图 3 报告专家评分：DeepSeekMath-V2 Heavy 在 30 题 Basic 子集上为 99.0%，在 30 题 Advanced 子集上为 61.9%。DeepSeekMath-V2 证明由作者方专家按 benchmark guideline 评分，而 baseline 数字来自 Luong et al.；专家身份、盲评、agreement 和原始评分记录未发布。论文也指出最难的 IMO-level 问题仍具挑战。

官方仓库核验了模型与评测 artifact：prompt template、inference/search script、部分竞赛输入和带自动/人工 rating 的 JSONL prediction。官方 Hugging Face 页面核验了 685B 权重发布，以及模型/仓库的 Apache 2.0 条款。两个来源都没有发布 D_p、D_v、D_mv、自动 hard-proof 标签、RFT 数据、GRPO 训练代码、reward 实现或有许可的训练语料。上述结果是作者在明确预算和判分条件下的主张，本 Card 不声称独立复现。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline has two poles. Final-answer RLVR offers cheap programmatic feedback but cannot judge a proof's rigor. Formal systems such as Lean and Isabelle compile proof terms and can guarantee correctness for the supplied formal statement, but require formalization and a versioned proof environment. DeepSeekMath-V2 occupies the middle: it scales learned natural-language issue finding without reference solutions, accepting judgment uncertainty in exchange for coverage of prose proofs.

The concrete contribution is a three-role feedback loop. Experts first label proof quality and verifier-analysis quality with the same {0, 0.5, 1} scale. A verifier learns proof judgment; a meta-verifier learns to judge the verifier's asserted issues; a generator learns both proof production and self-evaluation from those learned scores. As the generator improves, multi-sample verifier and meta-verifier judgments automatically label new hard proofs, replacing human annotation in the final two iterations.

The distinctive data change is not simply more proofs. Each stage adds a different feedback object: (problem, proof, expert score), (problem, proof, verifier analysis, expert meta-score), generator proof plus self-analysis and self-score, and later proof plus a set of verifier analyses, meta-assessments, validation votes, selected label, and routing decision. This is a reusable conceptual schema for learned-verifier research even though the actual records are unavailable.

GRPO, model judges, self-refinement, rejection fine-tuning, and best-of-many search are not individually new. Nor does the paper establish formal verification, independent verifier diversity, or an open training recipe. Its direction signal is the coupling of verifier scaling with data construction: increased judgment compute changes which hard proofs become positive or negative training labels.

Before reuse, readers must obtain or recreate expert protocols, per-class calibration, n/m/k, independent verifier diversity, automatic-label error rates, human-routing and discard logs, source rights, contest-overlap checks, GRPO/RFT code, and item-level checkpoint lineage. Without them, the paper is an auditable frontier recipe and evaluation release, not a reusable training-data release.

既有工作基线有两个端点。Final-answer RLVR 提供廉价 programmatic feedback，却无法判断证明严谨性；Lean 和 Isabelle 等形式系统通过编译 proof term，可以对给定形式陈述保证正确性，但需要形式化和版本化证明环境。DeepSeekMath-V2 位于两者之间：它在无参考答案的自然语言证明上扩展 learned issue finding，以判断不确定性换取对文本证明的覆盖。

具体贡献是三角色反馈闭环。专家先用同一 {0, 0.5, 1} 标度标注 proof quality 和 verifier-analysis quality；verifier 学习判断证明，meta-verifier 学习判断 verifier 提出的缺陷，generator 从这些 learned score 中同时学习证明生成和自评。随着 generator 变强，多次采样的 verifier 与 meta-verifier 判断自动标注新 hard proof，并在最后两轮替代人工标注。

有区别的数据变化并非简单增加证明数量。每个阶段加入不同 feedback object：(problem, proof, expert score)、(problem, proof, verifier analysis, expert meta-score)、generator proof 加 self-analysis 与 self-score，以及后期的 proof 加多组 verifier analysis、meta-assessment、validation vote、选定标签与 routing decision。即使实际记录不可用，这仍是 learned-verifier 研究可复用的概念 schema。

GRPO、model judge、self-refinement、rejection fine-tuning 和 best-of-many search 单独看都不是新方法。论文也没有确立形式验证、独立 verifier 多样性或开放训练配方。其方向信号是 verifier scaling 与数据构造的耦合：增加判断计算量会改变哪些 hard proof 成为正负训练标签。

复用前，读者必须获得或重建专家 protocol、分类别校准、n/m/k、独立 verifier diversity、自动标签错误率、人工转交与丢弃日志、来源权利、竞赛 overlap 检查、GRPO/RFT 代码和 item-level checkpoint lineage。在这些缺失时，本论文是可审计的前沿配方和评测发布，而不是可复用训练数据发布。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• False rigor is an observed reward failure. Initial verifier RL directly rewards the extracted {0, 0.5, 1} score and output format, so a verifier can match the expert scalar while inventing nonexistent defects. Meta-verification reduces this surface but is itself a learned judge trained from undisclosed expert records, not a proof oracle.
  • Appendix A.3 leaves false negatives unpenalized. Its rubric says a no-defect verifier analysis should be considered reasonable even if the proof is obviously wrong. Meta-verification therefore checks whether asserted defects are valid; it does not directly punish a verifier for failing to assert a real defect.
  • Correlated verifier blindness can become a positive label. In automatic labeling, a proof receives 1 when no legitimate issue is found across n sampled analyses. Generator, verifier, and meta-verifier share model-family and iterative checkpoint lineage, and the final model performs both generation and verification at test time. Repeated agreement can amplify a shared blind spot rather than eliminate it.
  • The automation contract is not calibratable from the paper. Numeric n, m, and k, sample independence, checkpoint diversity, tie handling, label distribution, discard rate, human-routing rate, expert-audit sample size, agreement statistics, and per-class error rates are not disclosed, even though the final two iterations rely entirely on automated labels.
  • A 64-of-64 pass is not formal validity. It means 64 LLM analyses under the learned rubric did not reject the selected natural-language proof. No Lean/Isabelle compilation, formal statement, kernel check, or proof certificate is present. Expert assessment of selected top proofs is stronger evidence than self-agreement but still lacks released identities, blinding, agreement, and full-candidate coverage.
  • Evaluation is partly self-referential. The D_v quality improvement is scored by the learned meta-verifier; one-shot and sequential proof correctness use the final verifier; Best@32 uses self-scores; high-compute search selects by the same final model that generates candidates. Independent human evaluation is concentrated on selected high-compute outputs and IMO-ProofBench.
  • Contest contamination is unresolved. Training prioritizes 17,503 AoPS contest problems after 2010, while evaluation includes public IMO 2025, CMO 2024, Putnam 2024, ISL 2024, and IMO-ProofBench. No crawl manifest, temporal cutoff, exact or near-duplicate test, solution-overlap audit, memorization analysis, or source exclusion ledger is released.
  • Training records and lineage are unavailable. Sizes and distributions for D_v, D_mv, validation data, generated hard proofs, rejected items, human-routed items, and RFT records are unknown. Expert protocol, GRPO/RFT code, reward implementation, optimizer settings, compute, dataset versions, and prompt-to-update checkpoint lineage are also missing.
  • Artifact openness is narrower than data openness. Apache 2.0 model weights, inference/evaluation scripts, selected inputs, and selected predictions are released. The AoPS crawl, expert labels, verifier analyses, meta-labels, automated hard-proof corpus, RFT data, and training code are not released or licensed for reuse. Weight and evaluation-code availability must not be described as an open training dataset.

• False rigor 是已观察到的 reward failure。 初始 verifier RL 直接奖励抽取的 {0, 0.5, 1} 分数和输出格式，因此 verifier 可以匹配专家标量分数，同时虚构不存在的缺陷。Meta-verification 缩小了这一表面，但它本身仍是用未公开专家记录训练的 learned judge，而不是证明 oracle。
  • Appendix A.3 不惩罚漏报。 其 rubric 规定，即使证明明显错误，只要 verifier analysis 声称没有缺陷，也应将该分析视为合理。因此，meta-verification 检查的是被提出缺陷是否有效，而不直接惩罚 verifier 未提出真实缺陷。
  • 相关 verifier 盲区可能变成正标签。 自动标注中，如果 n 个采样 analysis 均未发现合法问题，证明就获得 1。Generator、verifier 和 meta-verifier 共享模型家族与迭代 checkpoint lineage，最终模型在测试时还同时生成和验证。重复一致可能放大共享盲区，而不是消除盲区。
  • 论文不足以校准自动化契约。 数值 n、m、k、样本独立性、checkpoint diversity、tie handling、标签分布、丢弃率、人工转交率、专家审计样本量、一致性统计和分类别错误率均未披露，而最后两轮完全依赖自动标签。
  • 64 次全部通过不等于形式有效。 它表示在 learned rubric 下，64 个 LLM analysis 都没有否决选定的自然语言证明。方法中没有 Lean/Isabelle 编译、形式陈述、kernel check 或 proof certificate。专家对选定 top proof 的评估强于模型自一致，但专家身份、盲评、agreement 和全 candidate 覆盖仍未发布。
  • 评测部分自指。 D_v 质量提升由 learned meta-verifier 评分；one-shot 与 sequential proof correctness 使用 final verifier；Best@32 使用 self-score；high-compute search 由生成 candidate 的同一 final model 进行选择。独立人工评估主要集中在选定 high-compute 输出和 IMO-ProofBench。
  • 竞赛 contamination 未解决。 训练优先使用 17,503 道 2010 年后的 AoPS 竞赛题，评测却包括公开 IMO 2025、CMO 2024、Putnam 2024、ISL 2024 和 IMO-ProofBench。报告没有发布 crawl manifest、temporal cutoff、exact/near-duplicate test、solution-overlap 审计、memorization 分析或来源排除台账。
  • 训练记录和 lineage 不可用。 D_v、D_mv、validation data、generated hard proof、rejected item、human-routed item 和 RFT record 的大小与分布均为 unknown。Expert protocol、GRPO/RFT 代码、reward 实现、optimizer 设置、计算量、dataset 版本和 prompt-to-update checkpoint lineage 同样缺失。
  • Artifact 开放范围小于数据开放。 Apache 2.0 模型权重、inference/evaluation script、部分输入和部分 prediction 已发布；AoPS crawl、专家标签、verifier analysis、meta-label、自动 hard-proof corpus、RFT data 和 training code 未发布，也没有可复用 license。权重与评测代码可用不能描述为开放训练数据集。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
The safe reuse class is evaluation and audit reference with model/inference artifacts available; training-data reuse blocked. Researchers can use the released weights, prompt templates, inference/search scripts, selected contest inputs, and selected predictions to study model behavior under the released configuration. They cannot reproduce the reported GRPO/RFT training or rebuild the verifier datasets from those artifacts.

For data construction, the paper supplies a useful conceptual schema: preserve the problem and natural-language proof, expert three-level score, verifier analysis, expert meta-score, generator self-analysis, self-score, sampled verifier set, sampled meta-assessments, validated-issue votes, selected label, routing decision, reward values, model/checkpoint versions, and lineage. A robust recreation should retain both asserted and missed defects, rejected proofs, disagreements, and human-routed cases rather than only positive labels.

For verifier research, use the paper to design four separate audits: scalar-score accuracy, issue-level precision for false rigor, issue-level recall for missed defects, and calibration against independent experts or formalized subsets. Include unrelated verifier families or formal checkers where applicable so multi-sample agreement is not only repeated evidence from one model lineage. Appendix A.3 should be modified if the research goal includes penalizing omitted defects.

For test-time compute, the disclosed 8-sample one-shot, 32-thread sequential, and 64-by-64 high-compute protocols support budget-matched ablations of generation count, verification count, refinement rounds, self-selection, and external selection. Results should separately report learned-verifier scores, expert judgments, and formal-checker outcomes when a formalization exists.

The paper is also a strong audit checklist for frontier reports: demand n/m/k, dataset counts, expert agreement, auto-label error rates, contest exclusions, source rights, GRPO/RFT code, reward logs, failed records, and checkpoint lineage. Until those are released, the appropriate use is method comparison, verifier failure analysis, and evaluation reproduction—not training-corpus redistribution or claims of formal proof validity.

安全复用等级是 可用于 evaluation 和 audit reference，模型/inference artifact 可用；training-data reuse 被阻断。研究者可以使用已发布权重、prompt template、inference/search script、部分竞赛输入和部分 prediction，在公开配置下研究模型行为；这些 artifact 不能复现论文中的 GRPO/RFT 训练，也不能重建 verifier 数据集。

对于数据构造，论文给出有用的概念 schema：保留问题与自然语言证明、专家三级分数、verifier analysis、专家 meta-score、generator self-analysis、自评分、采样 verifier 集、采样 meta-assessment、有效缺陷投票、选定标签、routing decision、reward value、模型/checkpoint 版本和 lineage。稳健重建还应保留被提出与遗漏的缺陷、拒绝证明、分歧和转人工样例，而不是只保留正标签。

对于 verifier 研究，可据此设计四类独立审计：scalar-score accuracy、针对 false rigor 的 issue-level precision、针对漏报的 issue-level recall，以及相对独立专家或形式化子集的 calibration。在适用时应加入不同模型家族 verifier 或 formal checker，使多采样一致性不只是同一模型 lineage 的重复证据。如果研究目标包含惩罚遗漏缺陷，还应修改 Appendix A.3 的规则。

对于 test-time compute，已披露的 8-sample one-shot、32-thread sequential 和 64-by-64 high-compute protocol 可用于预算匹配的 ablation，分别考察 generation count、verification count、refinement round、self-selection 和 external selection。有形式化版本时，结果应分别报告 learned-verifier score、专家判断和 formal-checker outcome。

本论文也是前沿报告的强审计清单：应要求披露 n/m/k、数据集数量、专家 agreement、自动标签错误率、竞赛排除、来源权利、GRPO/RFT 代码、reward log、失败记录和 checkpoint lineage。在这些信息发布前，适当用途是方法比较、verifier failure analysis 和 evaluation reproduction，而不是训练语料再分发或形式证明有效性主张。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the verifier boundary explicit: scores 0, 0.5, and 1 are learned natural-language judgments; only the format check is programmatic, and no Lean/Isabelle proof certificate is produced.
  • Read Sections 2.1–2.3 together: expert proof labels train the verifier, expert analysis-quality labels train the meta-verifier, and the last two iterations use symbolic n/m/k multi-sampling to replace human labels.
  • Treat the 0.85-to-0.96 analysis-quality result as meta-verifier-rated on an unspecified validation split, not independent proof-correctness evidence.
  • Bind headline contest scores to high-compute conditions: one model generates and verifies, 64 proofs receive 64 analyses each, refinement runs up to 16 rounds, and experts grade selected highest-scoring proofs.
  • “Passes all 64” is an LLM-agreement stopping rule; Appendix A.3's no-defect rule and shared model lineage leave correlated false-negative risk.
  • Model weights, inference/evaluation code, selected inputs, and predictions are open artifacts, but the AoPS crawl, expert labels, automatic hard-proof records, GRPO/RFT pipeline, and training licenses are not released.

• 明确 verifier 边界：0、0.5 和 1 是学习得到的自然语言判断；只有 format check 是 programmatic，方法不产生 Lean/Isabelle proof certificate。
  • 将 2.1–2.3 节连起来阅读：专家 proof label 训练 verifier，专家 analysis-quality label 训练 meta-verifier，最后两轮用符号化 n/m/k 多采样替代人工标签。
  • 将 analysis quality 从 0.85 到 0.96 的结果理解为在大小未知 validation split 上由 meta-verifier 评分，而非独立 proof-correctness 证据。
  • 将 headline 竞赛分数绑定 high-compute 条件：同一模型生成并验证，每题 64 份证明各接受 64 个 analysis，最多 refinement 16 轮，再由专家评价选定最高分证明。
  • “通过全部 64 次”是 LLM 一致性停止规则；Appendix A.3 的 no-defect 规则和共享模型 lineage 仍带来相关假阴性风险。
  • 模型权重、inference/evaluation 代码、部分输入和 prediction 是开放 artifact，但 AoPS crawl、专家标签、自动 hard-proof 记录、GRPO/RFT 流水线和训练数据许可均未发布。

引用
